# SAW — Simple Agent Wallet

> Powered by AxLabs (https://axlabs.com)

CLI for agent wallets and x402 payments (EVM, Solana, Hedera).

## Docs

- Agent manual: /agents.md
- Human docs: /docs/
- Releases: https://github.com/AxLabs/simple-agent-wallet/releases
- Source: https://github.com/AxLabs/simple-agent-wallet

## Install

Download binary from GitHub Releases. `saw version` to verify.

Agent skill:

```
npx skills add AxLabs/simple-agent-wallet --skill saw -g -y
```

## Core commands

```
saw init
saw init status
saw inspect <url> [--method POST --data '...']
saw pay <url> --confirm [--method POST --data '...']
```

Do not scrape PAYMENT-REQUIRED headers with curl — use saw inspect/pay.

Secrets never on argv (stdin/prompts only). Wallet: ~/.config/saw/wallet.json
